name: comp-182
blurb: Switch with moon and sun icons as clickable labels.
description: Dark/light mode toggle with state-dependent icon labels and clickable icon buttons on both sides.
use_when: Prominent theme switching in headers or settings with clear visual iconography.
avoid_when: When space is very limited or when icon meanings might be unclear.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with aria-label and aria-labelledby for context, icons as clickable targets.
